create_outlier_detector_model: create an OutlierDetectorModel with additive decomposition and default IQR multiplier of 3.0
fit_outlier_detector: fit the OutlierDetectorModel on time series data with optional historical data for outlier detection
predict_anomaly_scores: predict anomaly scores for time series data using the fitted OutlierDetectorModel
serialize_outlier_model: serialize the OutlierDetectorModel to JSON bytes for later deserialization and reuse
fit_predict_outliers: fit the OutlierDetectorModel and return anomaly scores in a single call
